title: 第一卷 第19章 前往枯荣药庐第一卷 第20章 小白有些不对劲
slug: 神女录从废丹房杂役开始
lines: 落云宗等级森严。
外门弟子听着风光，实则只比杂役高出半头，顶多也就是不用干杂事，可以接任务赚灵石，多一些选择。
而内门弟子，才是宗门真正的根基，享有极高的修炼资源。
至于内门执法堂，掌管宗门刑罚，先斩后奏，杀个杂役或者外门弟子连理由都不需要。
曹阳无奈摇头。
现在确实还不能直接杀人。
真把执法堂的人引来，自己这点底牌根本不够看。
“那这些天就辛苦你好好练习炼丹了。”曹阳神色恢复平静，轻声安抚。
张娴雅听到主人关心，满眼感动。
她下意识去解腰间的储物袋，想把那本新领的初级炼丹术拿出来，“主人，奴家这里有宗门发的炼丹术，您要不要先看看？”
“不用了。”曹阳摆手拒绝。
那种烂大街的货色他没兴趣。
“等你拜师成功，拿到真正的传承再来见我，这几天安心备战，别分心。”
张娴雅郑重点头，“奴家明白，就算拼了这条命，也一定为主人赢下赵丹师的传承！”
表完忠心，又微微欠身，离开了茅草屋。
曹阳这才打开了她之前带过来的布袋子，倒出来看了一眼，十分满意。
这么多废丹，配合自己的净元之体和刚突破的炼气四层修为，应对毒瘴应该差不多了。
曹阳心头一阵火热。
等进入枯荣药庐，拿到洗灵草，再用阴阳造化鼎狠狠合成一番，自己这五行杂灵根到底能蜕变到什么地步？
前途一片大好啊。
“你疯了吧？”小白从床角蹿到桌面上，之前对曹阳生出的光环全部破碎，满是看傻子的神情。
它凑近闻了闻那些废丹，有些嫌弃，“这可是废丹，里面的丹毒不比毒瘴里的毒气差多少，你吃这玩意，到底是想解毒，还是想自杀？”
“别到时候药庐没进去，你先把自己毒死了，本姑娘可不想给你陪葬！”
曹阳根本不搭理它。
拿出阴阳造化鼎，将这二十一枚解毒丹废丹全部扔了进去。
半柱香后。
两枚散发着淡淡清香的绿色丹药静静便出现在了曹阳掌心。
他看了看，眼中闪过一丝喜色。
这次合成两枚一阶八品解毒丹，居然只消耗了八缕阴阳之气。
看来自己突破到炼气四层，经脉拓宽，连带着催动造化鼎的消耗也大幅度降低了。
曹阳随手捏起一枚绿油油的丹药，在小白眼前晃了晃。
小白原本还在喋喋不休地嘲讽，此刻声音却戛然而止。
小嘴巴微微张大，眼睛死死地盯着曹阳手中的丹药。
一阶八品？！
刚刚那二十多颗全是剧毒的垃圾，怎么变成了一阶八品？
就算是那些顶级的人族炼丹宗师，也不可能做到这种化腐朽为神奇的离谱手段吧？
这完全违背了修仙界的常理！
content_en:
Luoyun Sect has a strict hierarchy.
Outer disciples may sound good, but in reality they are only half a head taller than a handyman. At most, they don't have to do chores and can take on tasks to earn spiritual stones, which gives them more choices.
The inner disciples are the true foundation of the sect and enjoy extremely high cultivation resources.
As for the Inner Sect Law Enforcement Hall, it is in charge of the sect's punishment. It kills first and then punishes. There is no need for a reason to kill a servant or an outer sect disciple.
Cao Yang shook his head helplessly.
It's true that you can't kill people directly yet.
If you really attract people from the Law Enforcement Hall, your own trump card is not enough.
"Then I'll work hard on you to practice alchemy these days." Cao Yang's expression returned to calmness and he comforted softly.
Zhang Xianya was moved when she heard her master's concern.
她下意识去解腰间的储物袋，想把那本新领的初级炼丹术拿出来，“主人，奴家这里有宗门发的炼丹术，您要不要先看看？”
"No need." Cao Yang waved his hand and refused.
He has no interest in that kind of shitty street stuff.
"Wait until you succeed in becoming a disciple and get the real inheritance before you come see me. Prepare for war with peace of mind these days and don't be distracted."
Zhang Xianya nodded solemnly, "The slave family understands that even if they risk their lives, they will definitely win Master Zhao's inheritance for the master!"
After expressing his loyalty, he bowed slightly and left the thatched house.
Cao Yang then opened the cloth bag she had brought before, poured it out and took a look, feeling very satisfied.
With so many useless elixirs, combined with his pure body and the fourth level of Qi refining that he just broke through, he should be able to deal with the poisonous miasma.
Cao Yang felt hot in his heart.
After entering the Kurong Medicine House, getting the Spirit-Cleaning Grass, and then using the Yin-Yang Cauldron of Creation to combine it, how far can my five-element miscellaneous spiritual roots transform?
The future is bright.
"Are you crazy?" Xiaobai jumped from the corner of the bed to the table. The aura he had towards Cao Yang was completely shattered, and he looked like he was looking at a fool.
It came closer and smelled the waste elixirs, feeling a little disgusted. "This is a waste elixir. The erysipelas inside is not much worse than the poisonous gas in the poisonous miasma. Are you trying to detoxify or commit suicide by eating this?"
"Don't let Yaolu go in by then. You'll poison yourself first. I don't want to be buried with you!"
Cao Yang ignored it at all.
He took out the Yin-Yang Fortune Cauldron and threw all the twenty-one detoxifying pills and waste pills into it.
After half a stick of incense.
Two green elixirs exuding a faint fragrance quietly appeared in Cao Yang's palm.
He looked at it, a hint of joy flashing in his eyes.
This time, the synthesis of two first-order and eighth-grade detoxifying pills actually only consumed eight strands of yin and yang energy.
It seems that he has broken through to the fourth level of Qi Refining, his meridians have been broadened, and the consumption of activating the Cauldron of Creation has also been greatly reduced.
Cao Yang casually picked up a green pill and waved it in front of Xiao Bai's eyes.
Xiaobai was still chattering and mocking, but his voice suddenly stopped at this moment.
The little mouth opened slightly, eyes fixed on the elixir in Cao Yang's hand.
First level and eighth grade? !
How did those twenty-odd pieces of highly toxic garbage just turn into first-order and eighth-grade ones?
Even those top human alchemy masters can't possibly do this outrageous method of turning decay into magic, right?
This completely goes against the common sense of the world of immortality!
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 19 Going to Kurong Medicine House Volume 1 Chapter 20 Something is wrong with Xiaobai
